tasks.label: 🚀 JARVIS: Start Full Stack
tasks.command: docker compose up -d && echo '\n✅ Stack started. Logs: docker compose logs -f backend'

tasks.label: 🛑 JARVIS: Stop Stack
tasks.command: docker compose down

tasks.label: 📋 JARVIS: Backend Logs
tasks.command: docker compose logs -f backend

tasks.label: 🗃️ JARVIS: Run Migrations
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend alembic upgrade head

tasks.label: 🔍 JARVIS: Migration Status
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend alembic current && docker compose exec backend alembic history --verbose | head -20

tasks.label: 🏥 JARVIS: Health Check
tasks.command: curl -s http://localhost:8000/health | python3 -m json.tool && echo '---' && curl -s http://localhost:8000/readyz | python3 -m json.tool

tasks.label: 🔑 JARVIS: Get Captain Token
tasks.command: curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"username\":\"${env:CAPTAIN_USERNAME}\",\"password\":\"${env:CAPTAIN_PASSWORD}\"}" | python3 -m json.tool

tasks.label: 📊 JARVIS: API Status (HUD)
tasks.command: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"username\":\"${env:CAPTAIN_USERNAME}\",\"password\":\"${env:CAPTAIN_PASSWORD}\"}" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['access_token'])") && curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost:8000/api/v1/system/hud | python3 -m json.tool

tasks.label: ☁️ AWS: Terraform Plan
tasks.command: terraform plan

tasks.label: ☁️ AWS: Terraform Apply
tasks.command: terraform apply

tasks.label: 🐳 Docker: Rebuild Backend
tasks.command: docker compose build backend && docker compose up -d backend

tasks.label: 🐳 Docker: Shell into Backend
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend /bin/bash

tasks.label: 🌐 Frontend: Dev Server
tasks.command: npm run dev

tasks.label: 📈 Open Grafana Dashboard
tasks.command: echo 'Open: http://localhost:3001 (admin / see .env)'

tasks.label: 🔭 Open Prometheus
tasks.command: echo 'Open: http://localhost:9090'

tasks.label: 🧠 JARVIS: New Migration
tasks.command: read -p 'Migration name: ' name && docker compose exec backend alembic revision --autogenerate -m "$name"

tasks.label: 🎯 JARVIS: Opportunity Radar (Manual)
tasks.command: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"username\":\"${env:CAPTAIN_USERNAME}\",\"password\":\"${env:CAPTAIN_PASSWORD}\"}" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['access_token'])") && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/briefing/opportunity-radar -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | python3 -m json.tool

tasks.label: 📊 JARVIS: System HUD
tasks.command: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"username\":\"${env:CAPTAIN_USERNAME}\",\"password\":\"${env:CAPTAIN_PASSWORD}\"}" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['access_token'])") && curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost:8000/api/v1/system/hud | python3 -m json.tool

tasks.label: 🌅 JARVIS: Morning Briefing (Grounded)
tasks.command: curl -s 'http://localhost:8000/api/v1/briefing/morning?tenant_id=794d9b02-2dd6-49f0-b5c1-9f7c0b3af4b1' | python3 -c "import sys,json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); print(data['briefing'])"

tasks.label: 🔄 JARVIS: Force Recreate Backend
tasks.command: docker compose build backend && docker compose up -d --force-recreate backend && sleep 12 && docker compose exec backend alembic upgrade head && echo '✅ Backend rebuilt and migrations applied'
